text.footerBlurb: A small family breeder in Omaha, Nebraska raising large, old-fashioned, straight-backed German Shepherds — health-tested, home-raised, and bred to be your family's best friend and protector.
text.aboutBody1: I'm Dawn Menard. I grew up raising German Shepherds and Shelties — my shepherds were my best friends and my protectors. After stepping away for about 25 years to raise my family, I'm thrilled to be raising these dogs again, this time with my four kids, ages 10 to 19, right alongside me.
text.aboutBody2: Our puppies are raised underfoot in our home and worked with from birth until the day they leave. Every one goes home microchipped, with a chew toy, a martingale collar, and starter food — and I'm always here down the road for any question you may have. These are big-boned, straight-backed, wonderful family dogs, and I'd love to help you find yours.
text.breedTitle: The shepherd, the way they used to be.

text.puppiesFootnote: New litters arrive throughout the year and reservations move quickly. Don't see the one? Give us a call and we'll keep you posted on upcoming pups, collars, and colors.
text.ctaBody: Call or text Dawn any time to ask about available puppies, upcoming litters, or just to say hello.
text.breedBody: Our dogs are the large, old-fashioned, straight-backed German Shepherds many of us grew up with — big-boned, above AKC standard size, and built for a long, sound life. Exceptionally smart, deeply loyal, and gentle with children, they are loving family companions and natural protectors when it counts. Every puppy is worked with from birth until the day they go home.
text.pricingNote: 2026 pricing: Males $2,200 · Females $2,000. $200 discount for Military, EMT, Fire & Police. Call or text to reserve.
text.dogsBody: Started from wonderful bloodlines out of Minterns and Royalair's German Shepherds. Every one of our breeding dogs is PennHip, DM, and Embark tested — pedigrees and results available on request.
text.heroBody: We're a small family breeder in Omaha, Nebraska raising large, old-fashioned, straight-backed German Shepherds — smart, loyal, and protective companions, born and loved right in our home. Every breeding dog is PennHip, DM, and Embark tested.
text.includedTitle: What comes home with every pup
text.healthBody: A big, healthy shepherd starts with the parents. Every dog we breed is fully health-tested, and every litter is temperament-scored before pups go home — so you know exactly what you're bringing into your family.

health.title: PennHip Tested
health.body: Every breeding dog is PennHip evaluated for sound, healthy hips and lasting structure.

health.title: DM Tested
health.body: Screened for Degenerative Myelopathy so litters are bred away from the disease.

health.title: Embark Genetic Testing
health.body: Full Embark panel on our dogs for genetic health and verified pedigree.

health.title: Volhard Temperament Test
health.body: Every puppy is Volhard aptitude-tested at 6 weeks to help match you with the right pup.
